name: Teshigawara Kotone
source: On the surface, she’s a well-behaved and quiet girl. Her family is wealthy and strict about education, so she’s very organized and diligent with her studies. However, Yukito is the only one who knows that she secretly works as a gravure idol. She seems confident about her body, using her H-cup bust as her asset in her activities. She’s friends with Yui and Yukito, and they often hang out together at school as a trio. Despite this, she has an obsessive attachment to Yukito, seducing him in a devilish manner. At the same time, she maintains a seemingly good relationship with Yui, but her true intentions remain a mystery.
